title: Cheap to Hypothesize, Costly to Verify: The Defense Surface of Agentic Vulnerability Discovery
abstract: arXiv:2609.35909v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Autonomous LLM agents turn vulnerability discovery into a repository-scale search: they generate many vulnerability hypotheses but can verify only a subset under a finite budget. We show that autonomous vulnerability discovery exhibits a hypothesis-verification asymmetry, where verifying a candidate hypothesis through reachability analysis, execution, and proof-of-concept construction is substantially more expensive than forming it. Under a finite resource budget, this makes autonomous discovery a resource-bounded selective-verification process, further exposing verification effort as a unique defense surface. We present RedHerring, which inserts certifiably safe decoys that divert verification effort from real vulnerabilities. Each decoy combines a CVE-derived vulnerability chain that attracts verification with a false bridge that keeps its dangerous sink unreachable. translated_title: 假设成本低廉，验证代价高昂：智能体漏洞发现的防御面
translated_abstract: 自主LLM智能体将漏洞发现转变为仓库规模的搜索：它们会生成大量漏洞假设，但在有限预算下只能验证其中的一部分。我们证明了自主漏洞发现存在一种“假设-验证不对称性”，即通过可达性分析、执行和概念验证（PoC）构建来验证候选假设的成本远高于形成该假设的成本。在有限资源预算下，这使得自主发现成为一种资源受限的选择性验证过程，从而将验证工作量暴露为一种独特的防御面。我们提出了RedHerring，它通过插入可证明安全的诱饵，将验证工作从真实漏洞上转移开。每个诱饵结合了一条源自CVE的漏洞链（用于吸引验证）和一个虚假桥接（使危险的汇聚点不可达）。防御者可利用私有证书高效地验证这一安全属性。
tldr: 该论文揭示了自主LLM漏洞发现中“假设易生成、验证成本高”的不对称性，并提出RedHerring防御方法，通过插入带有可验证证书的安全诱饵来消耗和转移攻击者昂贵的验证资源，从而保护真实漏洞不被发现。
en_tdlr: The paper reveals a hypothesis-verification asymmetry in autonomous LLM vulnerability discovery and proposes RedHerring, a defense that inserts certifiably safe decoys to divert and exhaust attackers' costly verification effort away from real vulnerabilities.
